Term1: Enteric fever (including typhoid and paratyphoid fever)
Text:
# ENTERIC FEVER (INCLUDING TYPHOID AND PARATYPHOID FEVER)

Enteric fever is a systemic febrile illness caused by Salmonella enterica serotypes Typhi and Paratyphi A, B, or C.

## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Sanford Guide article: Typhoid Fever, Enteric Fever
DOI: 10.1093/cid/cix669-Shane et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2017, 65(12):45-80
Up-to-Date article: Treatment and prevention of enteric (typhoid and paratyphoid) fever
Therapy:
## Primary treatment

Hydration and electrolyte replacement

## Antimicrobial Treatment

## 

Consult Infectious Diseases for duration of therapy.
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M]
